checkpoints.Soil check: Record a new soil test and pH reading before confirming correction work. Compare representative parts of the field.
checkpoints.Crop inspection: Record canopy development and pest observations. Escalate new stress before continuing the schedule.
checkpoints.Harvest: Confirm maturity, grain moisture, and machinery readiness. Record yield and retained residues.
checkpoints.Field preparation: Check trafficability, residues, and equipment. Postpone work if the field is too wet or unworkable.
checkpoints.Crop rotation: Confirm seed availability, soil readiness, and the latest forecast. Review the next season after harvest.
checkpoints.Irrigation: Recheck root-zone moisture after the next watering or rain. Adjust the next operation to observed conditions.
checkpoints.Nutrition: Use the fresh soil test to set the application plan. Record the product, rate, and application conditions.

contingencies.action: Recheck root-zone moisture, review irrigation availability, and reassess the planting window.

contingencies.condition: Rain or saturated soil near field work
contingencies.action: Delay machinery passes until the ground is workable; revise the preparation and planting events together.

contingencies.condition: Soil test differs from this baseline
contingencies.action: Review the correction and nutrient plan using the new result before confirming application work.

contingencies.condition: New crop stress or pest pressure
contingencies.action: Add an inspection and revisit the sequence before committing to the longer-term rotation.

soil-review.title: Check soil and rotation readiness
soil-review.description: Collect samples across South Pasture, including the weaker growth zones. Review pH, available nutrients, and root-zone moisture before confirming the next operations.
soil-review.rationale: Current pH 6.6, nitrogen 45 mg/kg, and moisture 67%.

inspection.title: Review crop growth and stressed zones
inspection.description: Walk the field and compare canopy development in the marked health zones. Record pest pressure and changes in the corn crop.
inspection.rationale: Follow up on the current crop health score of 94/100.

harvest.title: Harvest corn
harvest.description: Inspect maturity and grain moisture, then arrange harvest across 28.1 hectares. Retain residues where practical and log the harvested yield.
harvest.rationale: Expected maturity window for the current crop and growing season.

cover-crop.title: Establish post-harvest cover
cover-crop.description: Inspect harvest residues and establish a suitable winter cover where conditions allow. Protect the soil between harvest and the next main crop.
cover-crop.rationale: A cover period is included in the gap before the next spring planting.

seedbed.title: Prepare the seedbed for soybeans
seedbed.description: Review the latest soil results, manage residues, and prepare equipment for the transition to soybeans. Confirm seed availability and the field's trafficability.
seedbed.rationale: Scheduled after the current harvest, aiming for 14 days before the calculated planting date.

rotation-2027.title: Plant soybeans for the 2027 season
rotation-2027.description: Rotate South Pasture from corn to soybeans. Check soil readiness and establish the crop within the calculated ten-day planting window.
rotation-2027.rationale: 92% model confidence. Starts with the regional soybeans planting window.

rotation-2028.title: Plant corn for the 2028 season
rotation-2028.description: Continue the proposed rotation from soybeans to corn. Review this longer-term step after the 2027 harvest and new soil results.
rotation-2028.rationale: Second step in the predicted crop sequence; reviewed as new field observations become available.

irrigation.title: Review irrigation and root-zone moisture
irrigation.description: Check water distribution and inspect the driest parts of East Ridge. Adjust the watering plan around the expected rain and record moisture after the next pass.
irrigation.rationale: Current soil moisture is 32%, below the field’s comfortable range.

nutrition.title: Review and apply the nutrient top-up
nutrition.description: Use the soil check results to confirm the nutrient plan. Arrange the planned application around the light rain window and record the applied rate.
nutrition.rationale: Available nitrogen is 12 mg/kg. Address the shortage before the next crop review.
